title: Scout Runtime Exception Record
description: Defines a structured runtime incident record for any event that causes Scout execution to deviate from the expected path. Exception Records capture detection, classification, trigger context, root cause, impact, evidence, containment, recovery, resolution, recurrence risk, learning value, timeline, ownership, approvals, and cross-object relationships.

trigger.trigger_summary: A product claim was not supported by the approved Product Passport.
trigger.raw_error_message: Claim could not be matched to authoritative product knowledge.

description.summary: The first content draft contained one unsupported product claim.
description.observed_behavior: The generated copy described a product feature not present in the approved Product Passport.
description.expected_behavior: Every product and process claim must be supported by approved authoritative knowledge.
description.user_impact_summary: The draft could not proceed to delivery until corrected.
description.technical_details: The standards comparator returned no authoritative evidence for the affected sentence.
reproduction_steps: Run the Product Standards check against the first Skill Output.
preconditions: An approved Product Passport is available.
The Skill Output contains product claims.

root_cause_analysis.immediate_cause: The generation skill expanded beyond the retrieved product evidence.
root_cause_analysis.root_cause: The content generation prompt did not require sentence-level evidence alignment for product claims.

contributing_factors.description: The generation prompt lacked an explicit evidence-bound claim rule.

five_whys: The claim was unsupported because it was generated from a general product pattern.
The general pattern was used because evidence alignment was not enforced during generation.
Evidence alignment was not enforced because the prompt only required a later quality check.

execution_impact.description: Execution paused at the quality gate.

deliverable_impact.description: The content package required one revision.

quality_impact.description: A blocking Product Standards check initially failed.

customer_impact.description: The draft was not delivered or published.

financial_impact.description: No financial commitment or loss occurred.

reputational_impact.description: The claim was corrected before delivery.

impact_assessment.impact_summary: The incident delayed the quality step but caused no external impact.

actions.description: Prevent the draft from proceeding to delivery.
actions.result: The affected Skill Output was marked as requiring correction.

recovery_actions.description: Remove or replace the unsupported claim using approved Product Passport language.
recovery_actions.result: The claim was replaced with supported language.
The revised output passed Product Standards.

recovery.result_summary: The unsupported claim was replaced and the revised output passed quality review.

resolution.resolution_summary: The unsupported claim was removed and the corrected package passed the Product Standards check.

follow_up_actions.description: Add a generation-stage rule requiring all product claims to map to authoritative evidence.

verification.result_summary: The revised output passed the blocking Product Standards check.

items.description: Blocking quality finding for the unsupported product claim.
Revised Skill Output with the unsupported claim removed.

timeline.summary: The revised output passed the quality gate.

communication.notes: The exception was resolved automatically before delivery.

prevention_actions.description: Require each product claim to map to an authoritative knowledge item before final generation.
prevention_actions.verification_method: Run the same workflow and verify zero unsupported product claims.

recurrence_assessment.monitoring_plan: Track unsupported product claim findings across the next ten content executions.

learning_assessment.proposed_learning: Product claims should be evidence-bound during generation rather than corrected only at the quality gate.
learning_assessment.proposed_memory: For BUXA product content, never introduce a product or process claim that cannot be traced to approved authoritative knowledge.
recommended_changes: Add evidence-bound claim rules to the content generation prompt.
Add claim-to-source mapping to Skill Output.

approval.notes: Automated correction remained within execution authority.

confidence.basis: Supported by the referenced Runtime evidence and validation results.

quality_state.summary: The exception record is complete and the incident was verified as resolved.
